newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, Atlantic Richfield buy US coal mines - paper.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, Atlantic Richfield buy US coal mines - paper.

text.p: Japanese trading house Itochu Corp and Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) of the United States have jointly bought three coal mines in Utah from Coastal Corp, also of the United States, for a total 70 billion yen, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
Economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Itochu put up 24 billion yen of the 70 billion yen price, adding that this was the largest investment ever by a Japanese firm in a coal mine purchase.
Itochu and Atlantic will form a joint venture as early as in November and sell coal from the mines in the United States and also export it to Japan and other parts of Asia.
Itochu officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
